 Starting XI: New England Revolution vs. Inter Miami CF

 Share on Facebook

 Inter Miami CF is set for its final away match of the regular season tonight, visiting the New England Revolution for MLS Matchday 34. Kickoff at Gillette Stadium is scheduled for 7 p.m. ET. Below are the starting lineups selected by both teams for tonight’s matchup.
 Inter Miami CF (4-3-3): GK Dayne St. Clair; D Ian Fray, Casemiro, Micael, Gonzalo Luján; M Rodrigo De Paul, Yannick Bright, Telasco Segovia; F Leo Messi ©, Germán Berterame, Riquelme Fillipi
 Substitutes: GK Rocco Ríos Novo; D Sergio Reguilón, Maximiliano Falcón, Facundo Mura; M Matías Galarza, David Ayala, Santiago Morales; F Luis Suárez, Daniel Pinter
 Head Coach: Cristian González
 New England Revolution (4-3-3): GK Matt Turner; D Ilay Feingold, Ethan Kohler, Joshua Wynder, Will Sands; M Carles Gil, Matthew Polster, Brooklyn Raines; F Peyton Miller, Dor Turgeman, Dániel Gazdag
 Substitutes: GK Donovan Parisian; D Andrew Farrell, Tanner Beason, Mamadou Fofana; M Diego Fagúndez, Jackson Yueill, Alhassan Yusuf; F Griffin Yow, Luca Langoni
 Head Coach: Marko Mitrović
